The general solution of the system is

$$
[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}]={c}_{1}{e}^{-2t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}{e}^{t}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

The line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$ has the equation 

$$
y=2x
$$

and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{1}{e}^{-2t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. 

Since ${e}^{-2t}\to 0$ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach $\text{the origin}$ as $t\to \infty .$

Let's add the solutions to the phase space.

$$
y=\frac{1}{2}x
$$

and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{2}{e}^{t}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. 

Since ${e}^{t}\to \infty $ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach $\text{infinity}$ as $t\to \infty .$
